commits.author: Vilmos Nagy
commits.message:
Update dependencies (February 2026)

As discussed in #64, I’ve updated the Cypress and Testcontainers dependencies within the same major versions. I also went ahead and updated all other dependencies to their latest versions, still staying within the same major versions.

I tested the changes locally on two projects that use this library, and both work without issues:
 - p2-inc/keycloak-magic-link (a PR adds tests in #166 and is waiting for this release)
 - p2-inc/keycloak-orgs (`main` branch)

I also pulled in the README change from #59, clarifying that users should use the same Cypress version in their Node.js project as the one used by this library.

Looking forward to your review, and thanks for your work on maintaining and releasing this library.
